subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Align
solution:
The correct answer is: **Disrupt**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Align"** means to place or arrange (things) in a straight line. It can also mean to give support to (a person, organization, or cause). (संतुलित करना)

 
 
• **Example: **The technician aligned the wheels of the car to ensure it would drive straight.
 
 
 
• **"Disrupt" **means to interrupt (an event, activity, or process) by causing a disturbance or problem. (विघटन करना)
 
 
• **Example: **The protestors aimed to disrupt the meeting by shouting loudly.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Align' **is **'Disrupt'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. Disrupt.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Position **(स्थिति): A place where someone or something is located or has been put.

 
 
• **Example:** He adjusted his position to get a better view of the stage.
 
 
 
• **Centre **(केंद्र): The point that is equally distant from every point on the circumference of a circle or sphere.
 
 
• **Example: **The fountain is located in the centre of the park.
 
 
 
• **Coincide** (मेल खाना): Occur at or during the same time.
 
 
• **Example:** The event is planned to coincide with the city's annual festival.
